title: M.Tech Chemical Engineering | KSDS KPGU
content: Admission Inquiry Academics / KSDS Chemical Engineering Krishna School of Diploma Studies offers emerging chemical engineering education focused on sustainable and industry-relevant development. LEADERSHIP NOTE Message From the HOD KSDS Mr. Jimit Kansara Head of Department, Chemical Engineering hod.ch.ksds@kpgu.ac.in Welcome to the Department of Chemical Engineering at Krishna School of Diploma Studies (KSDS), one of the constituent schools of KPGU, Vadodara. The prime focus of our curriculum is to impart technical knowledge, promote problem-solving abilities and build innovation around new-age technologies. Course contents are periodically updated based on recent trends and developments. Activities such as expert lectures, industrial visits, project and activity-based learning are carried out for technical and soft-skill development. We also emphasize safety, environmental awareness, and social responsibility. ABOUT DEPARTMENT Chemical Engineering at KSDS 01 Chemical Engineering Department at KSDS, KPGU was established in 2023 and is one of the premier chemical engineering education centers in Gujarat. 02 The department has qualified faculty members with diverse expertise and a blend of industrial, research and academic backgrounds that supports intellectual and professional growth for students. 03 The department is recognized through representation of dedicated faculty members at national and international platforms and is committed to socially responsible and research-oriented growth. 04 To augment teaching, learning and research, the department has state-of-art laboratories and a departmental library for ready references. Industrial visits, workshops and expert talks are regular features. VALUES & GOALS Vision & Mission Vision To be a global leading chemical engineering department imparting quality education, training and conducting research in chemical and allied interdisciplinary areas for the sustainable development of the society. 01 To develop and mentor socially responsible, environmentally conscious and ethically upright professionals, equipped with state-of-the-art knowledge and skills. 02 To interact continuously with the industries and society at large to respond effectively to their needs. 03 To foster industry-academia relationships for mutual benefit, development and growth. 04 To prepare competent chemical engineers with leadership qualities. 05 To develop modern chemical engineering laboratories and research facilities.
